A skeletal centaur-lord of the death-plains, four bleached horse-bones fused to a warrior's ribcage, a tarnished crown of antlers crowning its skull, drawing a bow strung with the sinew of fallen kings.

An undead empress in crumbling silk robes embroidered with silver death-moths, a veil of black webbing drawn across her gaunt preserved face, her fingers trailing ghostly chains connected to a dozen bound phantom servants.

A lich-jester in rotted motley rags, a cracked skull leering beneath a moldering three-pointed hat with dead bells, juggling three screaming trapped souls like burning spheres, shadow pooling beneath its dancing feet.

A bone-titan formed from the fused remains of giants, standing three stories tall, ribs like fortress walls, a crown of collapsed towers balanced on a massive fleshless skull, ground cracking under each footfall.

A drowned revenant lord in rusted chainmail festooned with seaweed and barnacles, black water pouring endlessly from the hollow of its chest, a corroded anchor-blade dragging behind it across cracked stone.

An undead war-witch in cracked leather armor stitched with finger-bones, burning violet sigils carved into her exposed skull, cradling a staff of fused vertebrae that hums with the voices of sacrificed souls.

A spectral dragon-lich, bones translucent as smoke and crowned in ghostly flame, vast phantom wings blotting out the stars, a roar that silences the living, necrotic light bleeding from every hollow joint.

A skeletal inquisitor in black iron armor engraved with judgment-scripts, a massive rusted scale in one hand, a flaming black torch in the other, empty sockets radiating cold absolute authority over the dead.

An undead forest-king with antlers of cracked bone growing from his skull, robes of rotted leaves sewn onto blackened skin, dead vines twisting up his limbs, amber-dark fire smoldering in his hollow eyes.

A risen sand-lich of the buried desert dynasties, wrappings of scorched linen unraveling in a hot wind, fingers tracing commands in the air that birth whirlwinds of bone-dust and screaming skeletal warriors.

A shadow-sovereign of pure congealed darkness wearing a crown of void-iron thorns, no body visible beneath robes of living shadow, two burning red points for eyes, the air around it going utterly, permanently silent.
A vampire lord in deep crimson and black robes trimmed with crumbling gold brocade, pale hands clasped over a jeweled obsidian chalice, ancient hunger burning behind red-lit eyes.

A mummified pharaoh-king risen from a shattered sarcophagus, linen wrappings soaked black with old rot, a cracked golden death-mask crackling with violet necromantic energy, skeletal fingers bearing rings of cursed desert gold.
A wraith-lord of swirling dark shadow and tattered spectral mist, a corroded iron crown hovering above a barely-visible skull face, darkness bleeding outward like ink through water.
A ghostly revenant knight in translucent half-visible plate armor, a broken lance still gripped in gauntleted hands, cold pale light radiating from a gaping wound across its chest.

A necromancer in bone-trimmed black robes raising both arms skyward, finger-bones of fallen enemies stitched along the hem, purple soul-fire erupting from outstretched palms, hollow eyes wide with dark ecstasy.
A colossal flesh-golem of stitched mismatched dead, standing three times a man's height, crude iron bolts piercing rotted seams, one eye a burning coal and one a dead white orb.
A banshee-queen of wailing mist, a silver diadem tangled in shrieking ethereal hair, her gown shredded into spectral ribbons, mouth open in a silent scream that cracks stone.
A skeletal warlord seated upon a throne of fused enemy bones, cracked plate draped in rotted war-banners, a broken crown still balanced on its skull, one bony fist gripping a notched axe.

An undead sorceress wreathed in writhing green soul-fire, her dessicated face half-covered by a shattered porcelain mask, long robes trailing shadow, hands crackling with barely-contained necrotic power.
A plague-lich hunched beneath a ragged hood, robes crawling with spectral vermin, a gnarled staff dripping black ichor, the air around it thick with luminous sickly yellow miasma.
A death-herald in tattered herald's tabard bearing a rotted sigil, hollowed eye-sockets burning with twin orange flames, carrying a cracked iron bell that tolls without being struck.
A drowned warlord risen from the deep, barnacled plate weeping black seawater, a rusted trident trailing kelp and ghostly brine, fish-pale dead eyes glowing cold in waterlogged sockets.

A lich-empress seated atop a floating throne of shattered black crystal, jeweled robes decaying but magnificent, skeletal hands folded with imperious calm, a withered crown radiating pulses of death-magic.
A shadow-revenant of pure compressed darkness shaped vaguely like a knight, a phantom blade of solid night in its grip, twin red sparks burning where eyes should be.
A bone-giant of stitched giant skeletons twice the height of castle walls, roaring with a hollow grinding sound, rusted iron chains still dangling from its massive wrists.
A cursed paladin turned undead death-champion, divine armor blackened and inverted, a once-holy shield now cracked and oozing shadow, golden holy symbols reversed and weeping dark ichor.

A lich-admiral in rotted naval uniform heavy with tarnished medals, a decomposed tricorn hat still set precisely on its skull, commanding ghostly ships from an anchor-staff crackling with storm-dark energy.
A withered death-priest in ceremonial robes of funerary black and bone-white, a cracked ceremonial mask fused to its face, raising a sacred skull-chalice from which black flame perpetually pours.
A skeletal huntsman mounted on a skeletal warhorse, both bound together by ancient cursed chains, a spectral hound pack swirling at their hooves, a bow of fused bone strung with a soul.
A revenant queen in blackened crown and disintegrating coronation gown, her skeletal face retaining traces of painted beauty, hands outstretched as waves of cold grief radiate from her form.

A necrotic dragon-lich with dessicated scales stretched over bare bone, hollow wing-membranes crackling with death-lightning, a horned skull crowned with fused dark iron, breathing streams of consuming black fire.
